content:
Apple's newly appointed CEO has officially set up his account on social media platform X, with the username @johnternus. His bio simply reads " CEO", and his first post also contains just one word: "hello".

Today marks Ternus's first day officially assuming the role of CEO, while the outgoing Tim Cook will transition to the position of Executive Chairman.

Overall, Apple's relationship with social media has always been intriguing. The company itself has an @apple account, but aside from running sponsored advertisements, it has not posted any other content. However, former CEO Tim Cook and Senior Vice President of Marketing Greg Jozwiak are among the executives who have public personal accounts.

It remains unclear what content Ternus will post on X, but it can be expected that his operating approach will be similar to Cook's era, including announcing news of new products and occasionally issuing statements on the company's various initiatives.

By next Wednesday, Apple is expected to hold its major autumn product launch event, during which it will unveil new iPhone and Apple Watch models, among other products. Ternus's account is sure to be very active during that time.

Ternus previously served as Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering for five years, having worked at Apple for a combined total of twenty-five years. His appointment this time can be considered a meteoric rise to the position of CEO. Outside observers generally regard him as a product-focused helmsman, whereas his predecessor Cook was known more for operational management.
